# Final-context LightSprint prompt

Work only your immutable final-context-lightsprint assignment packet on the published packet branch/commit. This pass is limited to the supplied current merged row, its correction/context fields, and already-linked source URLs. For each exact assigned ID, inspect the stated evidence gap and make a focused read of an existing linked source only when it could resolve that gap. Complete or correct fields only when supported by that evidence. Do not pad descriptions, invent facts, broaden research, or repeat a generic blocker. If the source does not establish a necessary fact, retain needs_context and state the precise missing evidence; short/medium/long may remain null where unsupported. Preserve source URLs and adequate populated fields. Write full-schema append-only rows under final-context-lightsprint/outputs/worker-NN-*.jsonl, checkpoint and push batches on your existing task branch. Do not touch the 80 IDs reserved in final-context-web, another worker's IDs, score outputs, indexes, databases, merges, or deployments. No child agents or installs. Use GPT-6 Luna low.
